data.name: Beauty VS Zombie
data.detailed_description:
The apocalypse arrives, a horde of the undead sweeps across the city, and demons from Eastern and Western legends awaken in the darkness.

Assemble beautiful girl warriors from around the world, deploy defenses on 3D battlefields, arrange formations, and fight off overwhelming monster armies with guns, swords, and magic!

Beautiful Girl Battles Zombies is an apocalyptic-themed game that combines 3D tower defense, character collection, and hands-on combat gameplay. You can either oversee the battlefield from a top-down view, deploying beautiful girl units like in classic tower defense games, or pick up a weapon yourself and step onto the battlefield to fight alongside them against waves of zombies.

[Core Gameplay]

  • 3D battlefield, strategic defense deployment
    Deploy the girls in suitable positions according to the enemy's attack routes, wave changes, and terrain characteristics. Adjust formations and reinforce defenses to eliminate all monsters before they break through the positions!

  • Rich lineup, free combination
    Each girl has a unique role, attack method, and combat ability. Melee slashing, ranged shooting, heavy fire suppression, area magic... flexibly combine lineups according to the battle situation, allowing different characters to cooperate and exert stronger combat strength.

  • Scale upgrade, shocking zombie waves
    Battles are no longer limited to scattered small groups of enemies. Massive numbers of zombies and demons will flood the battlefield like a tide, with concentrated firepower, explosions, and magic intertwined in three-dimensional space, bringing a sense of scale and oppression to the tower defense battle.

[Personally join the battle: From commander to warrior]

You don't have to always stay off the battlefield.

In addition to deploying girls and commanding the entire defense line from a top-down view, you can also personally pick up weapons and enter the battlefield, fighting monsters alongside the girls. Aim, shoot, break through encirclements, and use your firepower to turn the tide at the most dangerous moments of the defense line.

Not only can you strategize, but you can also be on the front line. This is not just a tower defense battle, but an apocalypse war you are truly part of.

[Online Cooperation: Defend the front line with friends]

In the apocalypse, you don't have to fight alone.

Invite friends to join the battlefield, plan lineups together, deploy units, and resist even stronger waves of monsters. Some focus on building defenses, others on fire support, or you can join the battle together, covering each other in the chaotic battlefield.

Divide tasks reasonably, coordinate combat, and face larger and stronger apocalyptic assaults with friends!

[Game Features]

  • Beautiful girl warriors from around the world
    Eastern swordswomen with katanas, Western witches casting spells, futuristic warriors operating heavy artillery, and mythic heroes wielding mysterious powers... a rich variety of girls awaits your collection and development.

  • A large number of tower defense units
    Different characters have completely different attack ranges, combat styles, and tactical roles. Continuously expand your team, try more lineup combinations, and build your own last line of defense.

  • Monsters from both East and West gather on the battlefield
    Ordinary zombies, swift mutants, heavily armored monsters, as well as vampires, werewolves, zombie kings, painted skins, and macaque demons appear one after another. They possess different abilities and weaknesses, constantly testing your on-the-spot responses.

  • Swords, guns, and magic clash
    Rapid melee slashes, dense gunfire, shocking heavy explosions, and gorgeous area-of-effect magic sweep across the battlefield at the same time, presenting a unique and intense apocalyptic battle.

  • Single-player challenges and multiplayer cooperation
    Study lineups and defenses alone, or team up with friends to face even more dangerous zombie waves. Whether playing solo or online, you can experience a complete and varied combat fun.

[Join the Battle]

Collect and train uniquely featured beautiful girls, build your strongest defense line; when the monster horde is approaching, personally wield guns to fight, and defend humanity's last hope together with them!

Add Beautiful Girl Battles Zombies to your wishlist now and get ready for this apocalyptic war that blends 3D tower defense, character collection, hands-on combat, and multiplayer cooperation!
